rationale: GpuSurface and GpuCompute stop calling dawnProcSetProcs directly and instead call the new framework-neutral pulp::render::ensure_dawn_procs() seam (gpu_proc_installer.hpp/.cpp), which runs Pulp's native default installer (gpu_proc_installer_native.cpp, now the only proc-table setter in core/render) once per process unless an embedding host registered its own installer first; a late registration is refused. Default behaviour for Pulp consumers is unchanged apart from installing once instead of on every initialization. No design-import, Chromium, rendering, packaging or authority boundary moves.
